title: Social Monitor: Romania records positive net migration for fourth consecutive year
summary: Romania recorded positive net migration for the fourth consecutive year in 2025, according to an analysis by Social Monitor, a project of the Friedrich Ebert Foundation, based on official data. The figures point to a shift from Romania’s traditional role as a major source of emigrants toward becoming primarily a destination for immigration. The country’s net migration balance stood at 97,114 people in 2022, 66,065 in 2023, 48,716 in 2024, and 66,920 in 2025. Immigrants are not exclusively foreign nationals, the Social Monitor found. Eurostat’s latest available breakdown showed that around two-thirds, or 184,700, of the 287,000 long-term immigrants registered in Romania in 2024 were Romanian
